ns2:course.label: Securities Regulation
ns2:course.description: Explores the federal securities laws governing issuance of securities in the primary markets. Emphasis on regulatory requirements governing corporate financing. 4 graduate hours. 3 professional hours. Prerequisite: LAW 633.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. 3 professional hours. Prerequisite: LAW 633.
